stable.notes: Fix Desktop 2.2 Dashboard crash caused by a missing time import when saving vacancy snapshots. The release pipeline now runs a dashboard-persistence smoke test before building and publishing.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.3.0 adds a guarded manual application queue for REVIEW vacancies. From Dashboard, REVIEW jobs meeting the manual queue floor can be queued for next-run application preparation without lowering global APPLY thresholds. The agent re-checks strong evidence, allowed location and 3+ years experience blockers before promotion, and final employer Submit remains manual.
